;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Colombian peace process]]
**The [[United Nations]] confirms that the [[FARC]] has completed its disarmament process, with former rebels due to make the transition to civilian life and the group to transform into a legal political party in the country. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/colombia-farc-rebels-complete-disarmament-170626232629067.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Bella Bond murder case]]
**Michael P. McCarthy (ex-boyfriend of Bella's mother) is found guilty of [[Murder (United States law)#Degrees|second-degree murder]] in the killing of Bella Bond. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/06/26/baby-doe-case-massachusetts-man-convicted-2nd-degree-murder-in-killing-2-year-old.html (Fox News)]
*[[Human rights in China]]
**[[China|Chinese]] political activist and [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[Liu Xiaobo]] is released from prison on medical parole after being diagnosed with terminal [[liver cancer]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/26/nobel-laureate-liu-xiaobo-released-from-chinese-prison-after-cancer-diagnosis (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] partially reinstates President [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Executive Order 13780|travel ban]] and invalidates certain injunctions that were put on the order by two federal appeals courts earlier. Final oral hearings concerning the legality of the [[Executive Order 13780]] will be held in October 2017 at the Supreme Court. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-40409490 (BBC News)]
*[[Unruly aircraft passenger]]s
**[[Alaska Airlines]] removes 11 passengers from a [[Juneau, Alaska]] to [[Seattle, Washington]] flight, due to alleged unruly and uncooperative behavior. There were no arrests. [http://www.ajc.com/news/national/passengers-removed-from-flight-for-disruptive-behavior-alaska-airlines-says/SumKK9ud3oIhtMbFw8mjVL/ (''Atlanta Journal-Constitution'')] [http://www.travelpulse.com/news/airlines/nearly-a-dozen-passengers-removed-from-alaska-flight.html (Travel Pulse)]

;Media
*[[CNN 2017 undercover videos controversy]]
**Three [[CNN]] journalists, Thomas Frank, [[Eric Lichtblau]], and Lex Haris, resign after the publication of a Russia-related article involving President [[Donald Trump]] that was retracted. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170627163719/http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/cnn-retracts-story-supposed-russian-meeting-48286362 (ABC News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/erik-wemple/wp/2017/06/26/three-cnn-employees-resign-over-retracted-story-on-russia-ties (''Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Mongolian presidential election, 2017]]
**[[Mongolia]]ns go to the polls to elect a new [[President of Mongolia|president]]. The centre-right [[Democratic Party (Mongolia)|Democratic Party]]'s [[Battulga Khaltmaa]] wins a [[Plurality (voting)|plurality]] of votes, but falls short of a majority, necessitating a [[Two-round system|second round]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-elections-idUSKBN19H238 (Reuters)]
*[[Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte]]
**[[President of the Philippines]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] makes another lengthy absence from any public appearance after missing the [[Independence Day (Philippines)|Independence Day]] celebrations earlier in June. Rumors about his health continue to circulate within the minority although government officials deny any issues. [http://www.rappler.com/nation/173973-duterte-no-public-appearance-6th-straight-day (Rappler)]
*[[Politics of Israel]]
**The [[Jewish Agency for Israel]] [[Jewish Agency for Israel#Governance|Board of Governors]] cancels Monday's dinner with [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to protest Sunday's decision by his cabinet to rescind plans for a mixed-gender prayer area at Jerusalem's [[Western Wall]], a compromise agreement reached after three years of intense negotiations. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170626095301/http://abcnews.go.com/Lifestyle/wireStory/jewish-group-cancels-meeting-netanyahu-protest-48276666 (AP via ABC News)]

;Sports
*[[2017 America's Cup]]
**In [[Sailing (sport)|sailing]], [[Emirates Team New Zealand]] win the 35th [[America's Cup]], 7–1, against [[Oracle Team USA]]. [http://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/news/article.cfm?c_id=4&objectid=11882009 (''The New Zealand Herald'')]
